title: The Color Code: How Gujarat Titans’s Identity Shapes Fan Belonging
dek: Colours and crest give Gujarat Titans a look. A consistent way of playing gives them an identity fans can recognise; the data shows whether they have one.
excerpt: Across their history, Gujarat Titans have been slow starters and mixed at the death. A playing identity that lasts is part of what fans belong to.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: GT have outscored the IPL in the powerplay in {{ev:cc-pp}} of {{ev:cc-ppn}} seasons.
They have conceded less than the league in the death overs in {{ev:cc-de}} of those seasons.
On that record they have been slow starters and mixed at the death.

sections.heading: More Than a Kit
body: A franchise's colours are its most visible identity, but fans also recognise a way of playing: a side that always attacks early, or one that always holds its nerve at the end.
The CricField warehouse holds no survey, sentiment or social-media data, so it cannot measure what fans feel. It can measure what they have watched.

sections.heading: The Batting Signature
body: Gujarat Titans have scored faster than the league in the powerplay in {{ev:cc-pp}} of {{ev:cc-ppn}} seasons. The chart compares their powerplay run rate with the league's each season.
On that record they have been slow starters.

sections.heading: The Bowling Signature
body: At the other end of the innings, they have conceded less than the league in the death overs in {{ev:cc-de}} of those seasons: mixed at the death.
A signature that holds across squads and captains is a sign of a lasting club philosophy rather than one generation of players.

sections.heading: Identity and Belonging
body: Whether fans feel more attached to a side with a recognisable style is a question about people, not deliveries.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: A Recognisable Signature
body: Gujarat Titans have been slow starters and mixed at the death across their history.
Making that signature deliberate, and explaining it to fans, is a way to give the colours a meaning on the field.
